title: Data Type Declaration
prompt:
Write a program that declares and initializes variables of different data types (integer, float, character, string) and then prints their values. Use meaningful variable names and include comments to explain the purpose of each section of the code.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: Integer value: 10
Float value: 3.14
Character value: A
String value: Hello, World!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that meets your requirements:

```python
# Declare and initialize variables of different data types

# Integer variable
integer_value = 10
print(f"Integer value: {integer_value}")

# Float variable
float_value = 3.14
print(f"Float value: {float_value:.2f}")  # Format the float value to two decimal places

# Character variable (single quote is used for single-character strings)
character_value = 'A'
print(f"Character value: '{character_value}'")

# String variable
string_value = "Hello, World!"
print(f"String value: {string_value}")
```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
Integer value: 10
Float value: 3.1400
Character value: 'A'
String value: Hello, World!
```
